nat_damage_multiplier: Attacks have a {chance} chance to raise that strike's damage to {mult}.
nat_execution: When enemy HP is below {threshold}, attacks have a {chance} chance to raise damage to {mult}.
nat_lifesteal: Converts {value} of every hit's damage into HP.
nat_poison: Attacks have a {chance} chance to poison the enemy: {damage} damage per action, for {turns} actions.
nat_stun: Attacks have a {chance} chance to stun the enemy for 1 action.
nat_extra_strikes: Attacks have a {chance} chance to follow up with a strike at {extra} damage.
nat_damage_reduction: Every hit taken is reduced by {value}.
nat_reflect: Reflects {value} of every hit taken back at the attacker.
nat_heal: At the start of an action, {chance} chance to recover {value} HP.
nat_low_hp_atk_bonus: Once HP falls below {threshold}, ATK +{value} for the rest of the fight.
link_ratio: The higher {stat} is, the higher the bonus damage (+ {stat} × {pct} dmg).
link_difference: The more {own} exceeds {enemy}, the higher the bonus damage (+ ({own} − {enemy}) × {pct} dmg).
